feat(dashboard): split LOCKED and POSTED into independent badges
commits.body:
LOCKED now derives from scheduler_state.pick_locked (the actual
truth source for "the model has committed to this pick"), with a
fallback to game-started time check when the state file is missing.

POSTED is a separate badge keyed off bluesky_posted on the pick
file. The two states are independent — the scheduler can lock a
pick before the Bluesky post succeeds, and a Bluesky failure
shouldn't make the dashboard claim the pick is still PENDING.

Visual: LOCKED green (existing), PENDING orange (existing),
POSTED blue (#1185fe — Bluesky brand).

Adds load_scheduler_state helper that fails closed (returns {})
on missing or malformed files, plus tests for all three branches.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
